name: Xerox B110

model_codes.value: B110V_BI (EU, also the code on the Israeli listing); B110V/BIUK (UK). 'B110V' is how Israeli and Polish shops write it. There is no 'B110V' with another suffix; the 'V' and '_BI' are Xerox configuration codes (BI = basic + wireless).

closed.includes: Body with Tray 1 (the fold-down front paper tray) closed and the output support folded flat. The B110 user guide gives 'width x depth x height 331 x 215 x 188 mm'. The plugs on the back are not included.

weight_kg.what: Xerox datasheet and product page; the B110 user guide gives 3.37 kg net with consumables

connectivity.detail: Hi-Speed USB 2.0 (USB-B), Wi-Fi 802.11 b/g/n, Wi-Fi Direct, Apple AirPrint, Mopria. No Ethernet.

paper.input_type: front tray that folds down; it stays open with the paper sticking out while printing
paper.manual_feed: No separate slot: 'Manual Feeder' mode feeds one sheet at a time from Tray 1

display: None: two buttons (WPS, power) and LEDs (status/wireless, toner)

toner.other: 006R04962 is the same 1,500-page cartridge for other regions; 006R04964 is a two-pack. There is no high-yield cartridge. The drum is built into the print cartridge (no separate drum).

in_the_box.items: Print cartridge (700-page starter), power cord, USB cable, Quick Installation Guide, Quick Use Guide, Safety Guide
in_the_box.region: Xerox datasheet (all markets); the same items appear in Xerox's official unboxing video and on Komputronik (Poland)
in_the_box.notes: The Israeli shops on zap.co.il don't list the box contents. A USB cable is included, unlike most printers.

ils.where: Nir Tech (ניר טק) via zap.co.il, free delivery; 7 shops ₪410-644

usd.note: not sold in the US; converted at the ECB rate of 16 Nov 2026 (1 EUR = 24.428 CZK = 1.1014 USD)

power.type: IEC C7/C8 'figure-8' 2-pin (inferred: the official video shows a 2-prong cord; the inlet is a small upright rectangle)
power.position: about 3.2 cm from the left edge seen from behind, 2.8 cm up (bottom of the port strip at the back corner on the control-panel side)

data.position: about 2.3 cm from the left edge seen from behind, 10.2 cm up (same strip, above the power inlet)

cable_space.confidence: medium: socket positions and the shallow strip are seen in Xerox's own video (frames 10, 11) and the manual drawing; the plug lengths are typical C7 / USB-B sizes, not measured on this printer
cable_space.why: Both sockets sit on a nearly flat strip at the back corner, set in only about half a centimetre, so the plug bodies stick out behind the printer (flat back under the user's rule). With the cables squashed against the wall the C7 power plug reaches 4.8 cm and the USB-B plug 4.6 cm behind the back (model build). Short plugs, so this is at the low end of the 5-8 cm flat-back range.
